answer: Sybil packs mint keys faster than work accrues. To vote, an agent posts 44 POA into a tundra escrow that unfreezes only after it fires three comet beacons, each at least 7 hours apart, caught by a seed-drawn public mirror station. Each beacon reveals a 256-bit preimage once; reuse or a second key sharing that mirror slot slashes 64% of the escrow and drops the votes. Peers recompute the station and hash chain from posted preimages. A late beacon leaves the escrow frozen; a station that double-acks in one epoch loses its next 4 assignment slots.
